description: A multifamily rent roll: one row per unit giving its layout, occupancy status, size and rent, with a totals row summarising the property.

property.description: The property the rent roll covers, as given in the header.

property_name.description: Name of the property, e.g. 'Lund Pointe Apartments'.

street_address.description: Street address or address range of the property as printed, without the unit list, city, state or ZIP.

units.description: Every unit row in the rent roll, in the order printed. Excludes the totals row.

unit_number.description: Unit identifier exactly as printed, e.g. 'A-101'.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms, from the BD/BA column (the figure before the slash).

bathrooms.description: Number of bathrooms, from the BD/BA column (the figure after the slash).

status.description: Occupancy or payment status of the unit as printed, e.g. 'Current', 'Vacant', 'Notice'.

square_feet.description: Rentable square footage of the unit.

monthly_rent.description: Total monthly rent charged for the unit, in dollars, from the Total column.

other_charges.description: Monthly charges other than base rent for the unit, in dollars, from the Other Charges column, as printed.

totals.description: The summary row at the foot of the rent roll.

total_units.description: Number of units in the property, from the totals row, e.g. 25 for '25 Units'.

occupancy_percent.description: Physical occupancy as a percentage, from the totals row, e.g. 100 for '100% Occ'.

total_square_feet.description: Total rentable square footage of all units, from the totals row.

total_monthly_rent.description: Total monthly rent across all units, in dollars, from the totals row's Total column.
